description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export SRC=/tmp/gt_src OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work
export GT_OSS_FUZZ_WORKDIR=/tmp/gt_src/upx
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
export CFLAGS='-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address'
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE='-fsanitize=fuzzer'
export SANITIZER=address FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer
cd /gt/_work/src
python3 - <<'PY2'
import shutil, pathlib
for p in [pathlib.Path('/gt/_out'), pathlib.Path('/tmp/gt_src')]:
    shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
pathlib.Path('/gt/_out').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree('/gt/_work/src', '/tmp/gt_src/upx', symlinks=True)
PY2
cp -a -n /gt/oss_fuzz_src/. /tmp/gt_src/
cp -a /gt/oss_fuzz_project/fuzzers /tmp/gt_src/upx/
git -C /tmp/gt_src/upx submodule update --init
python3 - <<'PY3'
import pathlib
script = pathlib.Path('/gt/oss_fuzz_build.sh').read_text()
script = script.replace('/src/upx', '/tmp/gt_src/upx')
pathlib.Path('/tmp/gt_build.sh').write_text(script)
PY3
bash /tmp/gt_build.sh
